name: DiscImageStudio
one_liner: A tool that lets any regular disc burner etch a visible picture onto the shiny side of a CD, DVD, or Blu-ray, instead of just burning invisible data.
buyer: A small gift shop, indie musician, or retro-tech hobbyist seller who wants to sell personalized or nostalgic physical discs as a novelty product.
business_use_cases: An indie musician sells limited-edition CDs with custom laser-etched cover art directly on the disc surface as premium merch.
A novelty gift shop offers a 'burn your photo onto a disc' personalized keepsake service for weddings or birthdays.
A retro-tech hobbyist shop sells nostalgia-themed custom-etched discs (retro game or album art) to collectors.

money_ideas.idea: Sell one-off personalized etched discs through an Etsy-style storefront.
A monthly 'mystery etched disc' subscription box for retro-media collectors.

steal_this: List a $15 'laser-etched custom CD' gift on Etsy this weekend using any home disc burner and this tool, marketed to the vinyl and indie-music nostalgia crowd.
